info.name: SQE3 L2 — Public Objects CRUD
info.description: Four independently runnable CRUD cases for https://restful-api.dev/. Setup is in pre-request scripts; assertions, persistence checks and cleanup are in post-response scripts. Only objects created by this collection are modified or deleted.

request.description: TC_DEMO_POST_001. Positive CRUD only. Precondition: no resource required. Postcondition: returned values persist and the object is deleted during cleanup. Runs independently; never targets seeded/shared IDs.
